## Savings Credit

To qualify for the extra Savings Credit you or your partner must be 65 or over.

## If your course starts on or after 1 August 2016

You must be 19 or older on the first day of your course.

#  3. Eligibility

If you have fewer than 30 qualifying years, your basic State Pension will be less than £122.30 per week but you might be able to top up by paying voluntary National Insurance contributions.

#  1. Overview

You can apply for a Tier 4 (General) student visa to study in the UK if you’re 16 or over and you:

* have been offered a place on a course
* can speak, read, write and understand English
* have enough money to support yourself and pay for your course - the amount will vary depending on your circumstances
* are from a country that’s not in the European Economic Area (EEA) or Switzerland

## Claiming in advance and backdating

You can claim in advance by up to 13 weeks (or 17 weeks if you’re aged 60 or over), for example if you’re moving. You won’t usually get any money before you move.
